reports.title: David Curry: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Mr Curry was treated for an infected obstructed left kidney and a left ureteric stent was placed as an emergency on 7 April 2023. Mr [name redacted] name was added to the NHS waiting list for Day Case urgent left ureteroscopy and laser stone fragmentation.
Evidence was heard that the risk of post operative urinary infection and sepsis is increased by prolonged stent dwell time.

Due to a lack of theatre capacity, Mr Curry did not receive a date for the proposed procedure at the NHS Trust and some five months following the initial procedure he approached Spire Norwich Hospital on 5 September 2023. The procedure was carried out on 15 September 2023.
Following the procedure being carried out Mr Curry developed sepsis and died on 1 October 2023.
